about.heading: About
about.content: Greetings! I'm delighted to introduce myself as Trisna Almuti, a recent Software Engineering graduate with an unwavering passion for web development. My fascination with this field began in 2020, and ever since, I have embraced an insatiable thirst for knowledge. I embarked on my journey by delving into the fundamental aspects of website creation, starting with the essentials of HTML and CSS. The deeper I delved into this realm, the more my passion burgeoned, leading me to focus primarily on the captivating realm of backend development.
about.content2: I am truly fascinated by the perpetual evolution of web technologies and their boundless potential. My enthusiasm for staying abreast of the latest developments in web development is unyielding, as I aspire to make valuable contributions to the projects I engage with. The realm of web technologies is in a perpetual state of growth and advancement, offering endless possibilities. I am resolute in my commitment to remain updated on the most recent developments within this dynamic field. By continuously expanding my knowledge and skill set, I aim to deliver meaningful contributions to the projects I am involved in.

skills.heading: Skills
skills.description: As long as I learn about web development, I can master several programming languages and also use the Laravel framework. Besides that, I can work individually or in a team, and I am also time-disciplined when working on projects. I always learn about web development and continue to develop myself in the field of web development.

resume.heading: Resume
resume.description: Hello, I'm happy to share about myself through this resume. In this resume, you will find information about my educational background, experience, skills mastered, and accomplishments. I have skills as a backend developer that I can apply to my job.
resume.summary1: As a recent graduate with a degree in software engineering, I bring with me a robust foundation in web development, which I have diligently cultivated over the past 3 years. This extensive period of study has equipped me with a deep understanding of the intricacies within the realm of web development, and I am unwavering in my commitment to continue learning and expanding my knowledge in this dynamic field.
resume.name: Trisna Almuti
resume.education2: Currently, I am completing the Informatics Engineering Study Program at the University Of Bina Sarana Informatika, which has a comprehensive curriculum with a focus on software development, web programming, and artificial intelligence.
